nodes.text: @MsMeppy @MrNixn @HumansNoContext HMPV isn't a new virus like twitter wants people to think. Its fairly common and is one of the multitudes of viruses that can cause the upper respiratory infections/colds. Its unlikely to cause a pandemic as it literally just causes seasonal sickness. We'll literally be fine.
